artworks.title: Façade de l'Église de Brou (Facade of the Church at Brou)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate church facade. The image depicts an intricate architectural structure typical of Gothic style, with a large central arched entrance adorned with detailed stone carvings and tall, pointed spires. Above the entrance, there are tall, narrow windows with elaborate tracery and a rose window. The surrounding scene includes piles of building materials and several figures engaged in various activities. The overall atmosphere is one of historical grandeur and dynamic activity.

artworks.title: Vue general de l'Église de l'Abbaye de Tournus
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street-level view looking towards a grand abbey-like structure. The horizon line is low, just above a bustling scene of people. The church's intricate architectural details are shown, with elaborate windows and arches. The scene has a monochrome color palette, predominantly in shades of grey and black. Figures are engaged in various activities in the foreground, adding a human element. In the distance, the church's high steeples stand out against a softly textured sky.

artworks.title: Vue de Rouen
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a European town with old buildings lining a canal. The architecture is detailed, with focus on textures and features. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey. A dock with barrels and goods is visible. A stone arch bridges the canal in the distance, leading to a brighter area.

artworks.title: Dordrecht (Old Warehouse)
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with a view of a town from the water. A boat with sails, masts, and ropes is depicted on the right side, framing the image's edge. The horizon is where the buildings meet the water. The buildings along the waterfront have different architectural styles. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching for detail and depth, showing reflections on the water. The colors are muted, primarily sepia tones, with light from the sky contrasting against the darker tones of the structures. In the distance, other small boats and structures fade into the background merging with the sky.

artworks.title: Cattle at Dusk
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with a stream, trees, cattle, birds, and a pond. The viewer looks across the stream towards the cattle. The horizon is high, and there are thin lines of foliage against the sky. The brushstrokes create detailed patterns in the trees and cattle. Birds can be seen flying in the upper left. The color palette consists of earthy browns and dark tones against a lighter sky. A pond reflects the silhouette of two birds. The rough ground leads the eye towards the trees and animals, providing depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Two Windmills at Montmartre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic etching featuring two windmills under a vast sky. The point of view is slightly elevated, capturing the windmills prominently. The horizon is situated towards the upper third of the image, with the windmills standing prominently on it. The technique involves detailed cross-hatching and lines creating a textured scene. The color palette is restricted to shades of black and white, emphasizing contrast and form. The ground is depicted with dark lines leading to the windmills and sparse trees, silhouetted against the sky filled with subtle line work hinting at cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Lock on the Canal Near Watford
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape overlooking a canal lock area. Trees and small structures can be seen along the horizon with intricate etching lines defining the scene. The canal's edges and lock gates are clearly outlined, leading towards the waterway. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white emphasizing contrast and details. In the distance, trees and rooftops are visible against the sky.

artworks.title: Moonlit Night (Mondnacht)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with high mountains in the background, a prominent cliff face in the center, and rugged mountains extending into the distance. The scene includes cascading waterfalls, rocky textures, and a figure sitting on a rock. The color scheme is black and gray, adding a timeless quality to the setting.

artworks.title: Landslide (Bergsturz)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky landscape with a high horizon line, showcasing a detailed style with varying shades of gray. In the foreground, there are figures resembling mythical beings interacting with the rocky terrain. A winding path leads the viewer's gaze towards a body of water in the background, surrounded by rugged terrain and patches of foliage.

artworks.title: Vaches Sous Bois
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof before lettering)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a path curving into the distance through a dense, wooded area. The horizon line is hidden by trees forming a thick canopy overhead. The artwork features detailed etching with intricate lines creating a textured composition. The monochromatic palette of rich blacks and sepia tones enhances contrast between light and shadow. A small herd of cows is on the path with a figure guiding them. The path continues into the woods, creating a sense of depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Peasant Woman, in Profile to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up side profile portrait of an elderly individual, focusing on the head and upper torso. The person is positioned in profile facing the right side of the image, with detailed facial features such as a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and visible wrinkles. They wear a beanie or cap, and a dark scarf or shawl around their neck. The background is plain, and there is a signature and date "W. Geirl 1874" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Jeunesse passe vite vertu!...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in full length. On the left is an older woman walking with her body slightly forward, holding a large sack in her right hand. She has gray hair tied back and wears a long, simple dress with a belt. On the right is a younger woman facing away from the viewer, with her body turned slightly to the left. She has short, curly dark hair and wears a red patterned dress with a blue apron. The background shows an outdoors scene with a bridge, trees, and boats in a waterway. On the top left, the words "Jeunesse passe vite. Vert !.." are inscribed.

artworks.title: A Shepherd Returning his Flock to the Fold
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a setting sun illuminating the sky. A fence stretches across the horizon with a figure and a dog nearby. A flock of sheep is in the forefront, with a small structure visible on the right. The artwork features soft brushstrokes and a color palette of earthy tones.

artworks.title: Paysage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a path, a low horizon, trees silhouetted against the sky, detailed line work typical of etching, a monochrome color palette of sepia or ink-gray tones, a figure seated under a tree with a grazing animal, scattered trees in the distance, wispy clouds, and a few birds in flight.

artworks.title: Une Ferme
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a farmhouse, trees, a shepherd tending sheep, and chickens foraging. The color palette is sepia tones, with a lighter sky and some clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Near Stirling
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a scene viewed through a stand of tall, slender trees with a few thicker trunks. The trees are painted with detailed brushstrokes capturing the intertwining branches and textured bark. The trees form a frame in the foreground, leading the eye towards a low horizon. On the horizon, there is a distant structure, potentially a castle or large building. The color palette consists of black, gray, and white tones, highlighting the intricate details of the trees and the subtlety of the background landscape.

artworks.title: The Churner (La Baratteuse)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with both hands gripping a staff placed inside a large wooden churn. The person's facial features are in shadow, and they appear to be concentrating on their task. The person is wearing a headscarf and a simple garment. A small animal stands close to the person's feet, looking in the opposite direction. The background is a dimly lit interior with shelves stocked with sacks or bundles. The floor has a rough, textured surface.

artworks.title: Woman Filling a Water Jug (Femme vidant un seau)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman pouring liquid from a large wooden container into a clay jug. She is dressed in historical working attire, including a head covering and an apron. The setting is outdoors, near a rustic stone structure with a thatched or shingled roof. The background includes foliage and a fenced area.

artworks.title: The Seamstress (La Couseuse)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a person sewing. They are sitting on a chair, facing slightly to the right. Their head is bowed down as they focus on sewing fabric. Their features are not clearly visible, and they wear a cap and long-sleeved clothing. The person holds a needle and thread. The setting includes a textured wall, a window, and draped fabric. The floor texture is visible and the scene is rendered in monochromatic style with a focus on shading.

artworks.title: The Diggers (Les Becheurs)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows two men working with tools on the ground. Their bodies are bent in concentration. The horizon is low, displaying a wide sky with textured clouds. In the distance, there is a figure lying on the ground. The style is detailed and etched, capturing textures in the ground and sky. The color palette is shades of brown, emphasizing form and shadow.

artworks.title: Christmas, or Folding the Last Sheep
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime scene with trees obscuring the horizon. A full moon illuminates the setting. A person, along with a child and a dog, stands near a gate leading to a thatched-roof cottage among the trees. The style is detailed etching with intricate lines and shading for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks and grays. Light and shadow contrast create depth in the rustic setting.

artworks.title: Jo Bap Piranesi Venet Architectus (Portrait of Piranesi)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of the bust of a man. He is depicted in a slightly turned position, facing slightly left from the viewer's perspective, with short cropped hair, a pronounced forehead, and a defined jawline. The man has a neutral expression, bare chest, and is surrounded by decorative elements resembling clouds or floral motifs. There is an architectural element below with the inscription “PIRANESI VENET. ARCHITECTUS." The background features swirling patterns resembling clouds.

artworks.title: The John Knox House
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate etching of an urban scene with buildings, signage, and details like windows, rooftops, and birds flying in the sky. The artwork features a three-story building with classic architectural elements, surrounded by other closely spaced buildings. Commercial signage, such as "KNOX TEMPERANCE HOTEL," is visible. The horizon is suggested by a line of rooftops and chimneys in the distance. Detailed textures of brickwork and shingles are rendered through cross-hatching and fine lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia and grey shades. Figures are depicted on the street level, conveying a sense of a lively urban environment.

artworks.title: Soldier Seated
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a man standing with one knee raised, possibly against a large book. The man is facing to the right, with curly hair and a beard. He wears a long robe draped over his shoulders, with detailed folds. His bent knee is covered with the edge of his robe, and he appears barefoot. The man holds a staff or cane under one arm and gestures forward. The background consists of simple horizontal lines.
